cells.requirement: The City Council instructed the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of entities using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on its use.

Landlords are prohibited from terminating tenancies without just cause and must provide relocation assistance for no-fault evictions under the Just Cause Ordinance. Additionally, landlords may not evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent unless the unpaid amount exceeds the Fair Market Rent for the unit's bedroom size.
cells.key_value: Eligible/Qualified amounts ranging from $11,000 to $27,400 depending on length of tenancy and tenant status

cells.requirement: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance are capped at 3% from July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026, and beginning February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

Landlords of properties subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance must pay tenants interest on their security deposits either monthly or annually, provided as a direct payment or a rent credit, after giving written notice of the chosen method.
